findings.title: Auth Gate Bypass
findings.body: `hasAssistants` is now enough to call `proceedToApp()`, even when `authManager.isAuthenticated` is false and no API key exists. A user who logs out, or whose session expired, but still has an entry in `~/.vellum.lock.json` will never see the auth window. They will land in the app with no usable credentials. Previously, the lockfile only decided whether to skip onboarding, not whether to skip auth.

findings.title: Dropped BASE_DATA_DIR
findings.body:
`LockfilePaths` no longer honors `BASE_DATA_DIR` and always resolves to `NSHomeDirectory()`. This affects any environment where the CLI or daemon writes the lockfile under `BASE_DATA_DIR`, such as isolated or test instances. In those environments the app will not find the lockfile, `lockfileHasAssistants()` returns false, and onboarding is shown again.

The fixture was changed to match (`os.homedir()`), but it still keeps `getBaseDir()` and `cleanupTestDataDir(baseDataDir)`. This suggests other components still use `BASE_DATA_DIR`. The result is a silent mismatch between where the lockfile is written and where it is read.

findings.title: Secret Leak
findings.body:
`logFixtureState()` prints the output of `defaults read ${domain} | head -30` to CI logs. That output includes `vellum_provider_anthropic`, which is the full `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in plaintext.

It also dumps up to 500 chars of the raw lockfile, which may contain assistant tokens or credentials. GitHub secret masking only redacts exact registered values and may not reliably catch these. The line that reads the key itself is fine, since it logs only the length; the full-domain dump undoes that.

findings.title: Security concerns
findings.body:
Sensitive information exposure: `logFixtureState()` writes the entire app defaults domain to CI stdout. That domain contains the Anthropic API key (`vellum_provider_anthropic`). The function also logs raw lockfile contents. Both may end up in CI logs or uploaded artifacts.

Separately, the macOS app now lets users with lockfile assistants skip the auth screen even without an authenticated session or API key. This weakens the authentication gate.
